channel.title: KPFK - QR Code
channel.description: From the creators of the nationally-syndicated show Civic Cipher, we are proud to introduce The QR Code! Debuting on KPFK 90.7 FM in Los Angeles, The QR Code is hosted by Q Ward and Ramses Ja. The acronym C.O.D.E. stands for Culture, Opinions, Dialogue, and Entertainment—the four pillars around which the show is built. The hosts hold insightful and engaging conversations on topics that are widely discussed in popular culture, social media, and traditional media outlets alike. Expect political discussions, world news, sports stories, and conversations on the social evolution of America. Special guests/experts infuse the program with a degree of variety and provide additional perspective.
